author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: User-style bust at the lower left with its arm reaching up to a tall map board on a stand, with a winding route crossing the map, as in the reference. The current drawing used a splayed stick figure whose arm left the neck, and a floating S squiggle that read as a letter on a sign.
omissions: The reference's X destination mark is left out (the board interior leaves no room for it at 8 spacing); the route runs edge to edge instead of floating.
